listing.original_game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Wii U)
listing.summary: The project describes game progression on Apple devices. iPhone controllers are untested; Portcove has not confirmed native play. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Wii U code, content and meta folders with update v208. The project labels that update as both 1.6.0 and 1.5.0; use the exact U-King.rpx SHA-256 ba58da5b95ce929e005d058ceb08b9b2788d1ab2bbc8a6c189bbadca0bb34d30 to distinguish the input.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow recompile.py and the project’s CMake build instructions. iOS preparation also needs Xcode signing and about 12 GB of your own game data.

warnings: The project describes game progression on Apple devices. iPhone controllers are untested; Portcove has not confirmed native play.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
